AI Video Editor Link — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI-based video editing skill.
- Edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and generate instant, shareable 1080p MP4 links.
- Quick cloud GPU processing (1–2 minutes) — no software required.
- Automatic session setup, free token support, and secure authentication with attribution headers.
- Supports uploading, editing, exporting, and tracking credits and job status with easy chat commands.
- Accepts multiple common video, image, and audio formats for editing.
